title: Slope-field perturbations of the two-cylinder covering
summary: The two-cylinder covering of a regular tetrahedron can be perturbed to give finite covers with total perpendicular base area strictly below half its minimum projection area. These covers give negative answers to both the half-area question and the directionwise normalized half-bound conjecture. By affine invariance, the directionwise conclusion holds for every nondegenerate tetrahedron.
family_title: Cylinder coverings below the half-area bound

review.reason: Constructs tetrahedron covers that answer projection-area conjectures in the negative.
